newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bonds end lower, not helped by rate cut.
newsitem.headline: French bonds end lower, not helped by rate cut.

text.p: 1600 GMT - March bond futures driven lower by U.S. bond moves, only brief respite after BoF rate cut. Curve steepens. *Mar 10-yr future 128.34, off 0.14. Vol 89,860. Open 128.26 *6.50 2006 OAT yield 5.83 pct vs 5.81. Bund spread -6 bp vs -5 *Mar PIBOR 96.68, up 1 bp. Franc 3.3750 vs 3.3727 per mark
